_comment: Second-look lanes: models from another lineage that attack a change. Copy this file to ~/.claude/first-principles/second-looks.json to override it. {prompt} is replaced by the brief. A lane whose command is not installed, fails, times out, or prints one of its fail_patterns is reported as skipped. A lane's report is at the end of its output file.

lanes.name: grok
lanes.note: Newest grok generation at medium, never -fast. Check: cursor-agent --list-models | grep -i grok

lanes.name: free
lanes.note: Free opencode model, read-only plan agent. Check: opencode models | grep free
